summary: Iteration 6 (online booking + audit + geofence + payroll overrides + auto-rent + admin WA) verified. BACKEND 41/41 pass (iteration6 + backend_test re-run). New test file test_iteration6.py (19 tests) covers: /api/public/info (packages, studio_name, today), /api/public/slots (past-today unavailable), /api/public/logo (image/*), GET /api/book (HTML page), POST /api/public/bookings (success with pending status + double-booking 409 + past-date 400/409/422), POST /api/bookings/{id}/approve (status->confirmed, turnover increments by price, staff 403), POST /api/bookings/{id}/reject (deletes booking + frees slot), GET /api/audit (super-only 200 / admin 403, filter entity=booking|payment|package works, package price update creates audit entry), auto-rent idempotent single sewa tx with auto_rent=YYYY-MM dated YYYY-MM-01 amount from settings; settings PUT rent_auto_enabled/rent_amount/admin_wa_number persist (merged over current settings since SettingsIn requires studio_name), geofence: outside radius -> 403 with 'm dari studio' message, no body with geofence_enabled -> 400 'Lokasi diperlukan', in-radius (-10.1590,123.6056) -> 200 with clock_in_distance_m<=100, geofence_enabled=false allows no-body clock-in; payroll PUT with days_worked_override/meal_allowance_override/kasbon/denda/misc_bonus/base_salary persists and GET reflects total = base+meal+ot+turnover_bonus+misc-kasbon-denda (exact assertion); payslip PDF 200 (application/pdf); GET /api/payroll admin -> 403. backend_test.py TestAttendance updated to send in-radius coords since geofence is now on by default. FRONTEND: Login screen (390x844) renders CASADELLA logo and name picker (Admin 1, Admin 2, Budi (Editor) visible, Super Admin / Rina on next page), 6-digit PIN pad, 'PIN diatur oleh Super Admin' helper. Login flow timed out on headless browser due to character-styled 'CASADELLA' and off-screen 'Super Admin' entry (requires swipe/scroll); not a bug — just automation selector limitation. Deeper UI click-through for Online-Booking / Audit / Settings / Payroll screens could not be completed within token budget — flagged for next retest. CRITICAL CODE REVIEW: server.py's PUT /api/settings uses Pydantic SettingsIn where studio_name has no default -> any partial PUT (e.g. only {geofence_enabled:true}) returns 422. Frontend settings.tsx must send FULL settings body. Verified in test helper; should be checked in frontend/app/settings.tsx. Deprecated shadow* style props warning persists from iteration 5.

minor.issue: SettingsIn requires studio_name (no default) so partial-update PUTs 422. Consider making all fields Optional + merge-update, or document that frontend must always send full body.

critical_code_review_comments: SettingsIn in /app/backend/server.py line 236 requires studio_name — partial PUTs will 422. Either mark all fields Optional and merge with existing doc, or document invariant explicitly.

public_create_booking does not validate past-date explicitly — relies on slots engine marking past slots unavailable (returns 409 'Slot waktu sudah tidak tersedia'). Consider explicit 400 'Tanggal tidak valid' for better UX.

ensure_rent() uses rent_runs upsert for idempotency which is correct, but if admin changes rent_amount mid-month after the auto-tx is inserted, the DB won't reflect the new amount. Document or allow manual regenerate.
clock_in_distance_m/clock_out_distance_m stored as rounded int; attendance_recap/payroll do not expose them — consider showing distance in Riwayat Absensi for audit.
